North Carolina 2024 Presidential Results Map
text: This map uses the official North Carolina State Board of Elections precinct-level results file for the 2024 general election. I aggregated the county totals for the two major-party presidential candidates and mapped the county-level Trump vote share across the state.

title: North Carolina 2024 Presidential Results Map
section: Map of Trump vote share by county
text:
Map of Trump vote share by county











Read the map


The county map shows the general pattern of vote strength across North Carolina in 2024. Darker red counties indicate a larger share of the two-party vote for Donald J. Trump, while blue counties show stronger support for Kamala D. Harris. The layered presentation keeps the information easy to read while maintaining a cleaner depth display.
